phase0_history.design: disputed the 2 Critical findings on a verified architectural fact -- FeedResult has no field capable of carrying row content or correction order under any grouping choice, and dskit.production.feed.ReplayFeed's own docstring states directly that row/correction order is the decider's responsibility via read_entry/inputs_digest, never the tape's, for every ReplayTape implementation including the pre-existing BarTape; accepted and folded in every Major/Minor finding regardless of the dispute (class made private, construction-time whole-or-nothing contract documented, framing corrected, matrix expanded)
phase0_history.review: fresh independent design skeptic, cold review with no knowledge of Revision 1's verdict, independently reread every cited file and confirmed the disputed architectural claim is correct: 0 Critical / 0 Major / 0 Minor / 0 Nit

reuse_confirmed.method: swept for any existing CapturedReplayTape-to-runtime-ReplayTape adapter before drafting; confirmed dskit.pipeline.trust.ReplayRun.run explicitly refuses today ("replay execution requires the F3 composed-tape broker (follow-on)"), and BarTape (children/intraday_equities) is the only existing ReplayTape implementation, over raw unverified bars, not verified envelopes
reuse_confirmed.action_taken: mirrors BarTape's exact shape and trust posture (grouping by the v2 tick field, availability_ms, instead of asof_ms); compose_replay_tape, BarTape, ReplayRun, and bundles.py itself are all byte-for-byte untouched

matrix_completion.implementation_correction: the ADR text originally proposed dskit.production.bundles as the class's home; RED caught a real purity-gate refusal (bundles.py's own test_bundles_imports_no_production_module_but_base_and_vocab correctly refuses importing FeedResult from dskit.production.records -- bundles.py sits ahead of feed.py/compose.py in the build order precisely because it depends on neither). Minimal fix: relocated to dskit.production.feed, which already imports records.FeedResult and already owns ReplayFeed, the tape's sole consumer -- a cleaner home than originally proposed, with no circularity. The ADR text was corrected to match post-hoc.
